intro: Moves the tables of {database} ({{engine}}) to the target database you choose, even on another engine: creates the converted tables (types, defaults, keys, indexes and names), copies the data with bulk loads and several tables at once, and adds the foreign keys at the end. If the app closes halfway, the migration can be resumed. The preview shows the report of every change and the script first, without touching anything.

hint.convert: Converts the structure to the target engine, creates the tables and copies the data.
hint.clone: Clone (make the target identical): between databases of the same engine, creates everything with the engine's own script and copies the data.
hint.sync: Sync only what changed: in tables that already exist, inserts, updates and deletes only the rows that differ.

clone.needConnection: To see the clone script, choose the target connection: the script adapts to what that server supports (it's only queried).
clone.help: The target ends up equal to the source: tables with their storage, indexes, constraints, sequences, code and other objects, with the engine's own script. What already exists on the target is left untouched.
clone.clean: The target can be made identical: no remarks.
clone.scriptHelp: It's what «Clone» runs on the target: first what goes before the tables, then each table with its indexes and, at the end, constraints, code and other objects.

sync.help: The tables must exist on the target with the same columns: nothing is created or emptied. Only the rows that differ are inserted, updated and deleted, in one transaction per table.

depths.fullHint: The whole content of each row.
depths.sizesHint: Large columns are compared by their length: much faster, but a change that keeps the same size goes unseen.
depths.keysHint: Finds new and deleted rows, not modified ones.

sync.keysHelp: Each table is compared by its primary key; if it has none, choose a unique key.

saved.notSaved: Not saved: it saves itself on the first change
saved.deleteConfirm: The migration «{{name}}» and its configuration will be deleted. Neither the source nor the target is touched: whatever was copied stays where it is. Continue?
saved.runElsewhere: This migration has runs, but not on this machine: only its configuration is shown here.
